gloss: to focus efforts on; to devote energy to
notes:
A somewhat formal word commonly used in business and organizational contexts to describe strategically directing effort and resources toward a priority area. Takes に to mark the target of effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～に{注力|ちゅうりょく}する: to focus efforts on ~
- {開発|かいはつ}に{注力|ちゅうりょく}: focus efforts on development
- {注力|ちゅうりょく}{分野|ぶんや}: area of focus
- {経営|けいえい}{資源|しげん}を{注力|ちゅうりょく}する: to direct business resources

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}する: to concentrate — broader; can refer to mental focus or physical convergence
- {専念|せんねん}する: to devote oneself — implies giving up other things to focus exclusively on one
- {力|ちから}を{入|い}れる: to put effort into — more colloquial and versatile
- {傾注|けいちゅう}する: to devote, to pour into — more literary; emphasizes pouring one's whole effort

REGISTER:
Formal. Very common in business reports, press releases, and corporate strategy discussions. In casual conversation, {力|ちから}を{入|い}れる or {頑張|がんば}る are more natural.

definitions.gloss: to focus efforts on; to devote energy to
definitions.explanation: to direct one's effort, energy, or resources toward a specific goal or task; to prioritize and concentrate efforts on something

examples.japanese: {新|しん}{商品|しょうひん}の{開発|かいはつ}に{注力|ちゅうりょく}する。
examples.english: To focus efforts on developing new products.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{海外|かいがい}{市場|しじょう}の{開拓|かいたく}に{注力|ちゅうりょく}する{方針|ほうしん}だ。
examples.english: The policy this year is to focus efforts on developing overseas markets.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}の{解決|かいけつ}に{注力|ちゅうりょく}すべきだ。
examples.english: We should focus our efforts on solving environmental issues.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{人材|じんざい}{育成|いくせい}に{注力|ちゅうりょく}してきた{結果|けっか}、{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{社員|しゃいん}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: As a result of the company focusing efforts on talent development, the number of excellent employees has increased.
